title: Production AI Receptionist Platform
subtitle: Built for real operators, not engineers
blurb: A multi-tenant voice platform built in about two weeks: VAPI plus telephony, tasks and transcripts, WhatsApp alerts to owners, human fallback, and a Next.js dashboard, built for real operators, not engineers.
result: Multi-tenant platform shipped in about two weeks
whoFor: Small business owners who lose calls and bookings because no one is available to answer the phone, and who need a receptionist system they can actually operate without technical help.
challengeIntro: Missed calls are missed business for small operators, but staffing a receptionist around the clock is not realistic for most of them. The tools that exist for AI voice agents tend to be built for engineers to configure, not for a business owner to actually run day to day.
challengePoints: Missed calls translate directly into missed bookings and revenue.
Round-the-clock human reception is not affordable for most small operators.
Existing AI voice tooling assumes a technical operator, not a business owner.
Needed to support many separate businesses (tenants) from one platform.
identifiedIntro: The platform had to be judged by whether a non-technical owner could run it, not by how capable the underlying voice model was. That framing drove the entire build, from the dashboard down to the fallback logic.
builtIntro: Covison built a production multi-tenant voice platform in about two weeks, combining:
builtPoints: VAPI for voice, paired with telephony integration
Task and transcript logging per call
WhatsApp alerts to business owners for real-time visibility
Human fallback for calls the AI should not handle alone
A Next.js dashboard built for operators, not engineers
whyNotOffTheShelf: Most AI voice agent tooling is built as infrastructure for developers to wire up, with no multi-tenant dashboard, no owner-facing alerting, and no built-in human fallback path. Making it usable by a non-technical small business owner was the actual product work.
productionReality: Live in production across multiple tenants, not a single pilot business.
Human fallback in place for calls that need a person.
Owners get real-time visibility via WhatsApp, without opening a dashboard.
outcomeBullets: Multi-tenant platform shipped in about two weeks.
Small operators no longer lose calls to unanswered phones.
Owners can run the system themselves without engineering support.
